held_source_feasibility.reason: The native baseline fits no source-specific parameter and can count support from remaining sources only.
held_source_feasibility.seal_status: No current source is sealed. A leakage-safe result is still exposed development evidence and cannot earn a champion.

known_biases_and_leakage_routes: Counting technical rows, accessions, aliases, derivative edges, repeated publications, or correlated replicates as independent evidence units.
Building genes, variants, loci, or the candidate denominator from held-source assay coverage.
Retaining held-source inverse edges, source nodes, provenance, observability, tested status, missingness, aliases, degree, source count, paths, normalization, or any deterministic derivative.
Thresholding continuous assay values into supported status after inspecting held or development outcomes.
Treating an absent, untestable, not-applicable, unavailable, source-dependent, indeterminate, or discordant record as a tested negative.
Allowing large or deeply assayed studies to contribute many units without reporting source-level concentration.
Using held-source prevalence or eligibility to fit the count-to-probability calibrator required for Brier scoring.
Splitting LD-linked variants, one locus, one gene block, or deterministic graph derivatives across roles.
Interpreting a high evidence count as causal support rather than study density and cross-source prioritization.

confounding_disposition.degree: Report correlation with graph degree and degree-matched performance. Evidence count is expected to share this confound.
confounding_disposition.observability: Report remaining-source observability strata. The held source's assay coverage is evaluator-only and cannot be a feature.
confounding_disposition.source_count: Report distinct supporting source families alongside raw evidence units so one large source is visible.
confounding_disposition.study_intensity: Report contribution by source family and deduplication attrition; do not outcome-weight sources.

license_disposition.output_redistribution: subject to source-specific graph data terms and aggregate-only project policy

remaining_blockers: Promote the corrected 50-study COLOC release and freeze one immutable graph snapshot, evidence ontology, source-family aliases, evidence-unit identity, statuses, provenance, native-build LD blocks, loci, genes, and candidate universe.
Implement the exact count and deduplication contract under a frozen project revision and terms determination.

Prove with synthetic fixtures that duplicate aliases collapse, technical replicates follow the frozen evidence-unit rule, opposite directions remain distinct, source-only candidates disappear, and non-supported states never increment.
Implement complete held-source removal before counting and reject any residual inverse, observability, tested-status, degree, source-count, path, normalization, or alias signal.
Freeze evaluator tie handling and a source-blind monotone one-dimensional calibrator if Brier score is reported; the native count remains the ranking score.
Hash graph inputs, canonicalization, deduplication groups, removed-source receipt, masks, counts, calibration, and predictions for every role.
Run only lightweight approved CPU-SLURM fixtures after campaign approval; no model job is currently authorized.
Keep results development-only and use prioritization language until a wholly sealed evidence source is registered and powered before outcomes are read.
